our_interpretation: The plain reading in context is that reliance on erroneous LLM output materially contributed to the April 2025 tariff decisions and resulting serious economic harm.
The concrete episode is the April 2 tariff announcement and its consequences through April 6, 2025.
Serious harm includes substantial financial disruption; the claim need not mean permanent economic collapse.
Support requires a causal chain from actual LLM use, through insufficient checking of erroneous output, to consequential policy decisions and harm.
The statement is broader than this episode. Isolated unrelated LLM mistakes would not establish its claim of worldwide harm in this context.
criteria.support_condition: Authenticated records or independently corroborated testimony establish that officials relied on erroneous LLM output when making the tariff decisions, and credible evidence links those decisions to substantial harm by the post date.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Reliable evidence establishes that the asserted LLM contribution did not occur, or that it did not materially affect the harmful decisions. A denial alone or lack of public documentation is insufficient.
